question: The base radius of a cylinder is 14 cm. If curved surface area of the cylinder is three-fifth of the total surface area, then what will be the volume (in cu. cm) of the cylinder? (Use π = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
**Given:**

The base radius of a cylinder is 14 cm

The curved surface area of the cylinder is three-fifth of the total surface area

**Formula used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48d06a81f3225373245277ee8385eaf7886bcc5ea76914a1aba2ea4fb01b2f63.png] 

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh

Total surface area a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)
